Typical summer conditions

Northwest Montana can have warm afternoons, cool mornings and fast-changing mountain weather. Check the forecast shortly before departure.

☀️

Warm afternoons

Plan for sun protection, water and breathable layers during hikes and lake time.

🧥

Cool mornings & evenings

Bring light jackets or sweatshirts for early starts, boat rides and outdoor concerts.

⛈️

Mountain changes

Pack a compact rain shell and keep optional activities flexible around weather.

Extra Family Adventure Ideas

Keep these as optional experiences if the weather is great or you have extra time.

📸 Photo Challenge

  • Ride the Red Bus
  • Spot a mountain goat or bald eagle
  • Take a family photo at Lake McDonald
  • Cross the Kootenai Swinging Bridge
  • Jump from the pontoon waterslide

🍦 Montana Bucket List

  • Eat a huckleberry bear claw
  • Try huckleberry ice cream
  • Watch the sunset over Lake Koocanusa
  • Roast s'mores at the house
  • Play family pickleball

⭐ If You Have Extra Time

  • Whitefish Mountain Resort Alpine Slide
  • Scenic chairlift ride
  • Polebridge Mercantile
  • Lake McDonald Lodge stop
